# GitHub Copilot instructions

Read the repository-root [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and [llms.txt](../llms.txt) before making changes. Root AGENTS.md is the canonical operational policy; do not create conflicting Copilot-only rules.

For edits under `d630-tiny/`, `d630-gentoo/` or `kernels/`, also read the nearest nested `AGENTS.md` and component `README.md`. Keep the two OS trees and three kernel profiles separate. Do not prune release tags or saved runner states outside the explicit cleanup policy.
